tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_1.csv')
def zscore(x):
    med = x.median()
    mad = (x - med).abs().median()
    return (x - med) / (1.4826 * mad)
df['z'] = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost'].transform(zscore)
top = df.reindex(df['z'].abs().sort_values(ascending=False).index).head(10)
print(top[['ChargePeriodStart','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','z']])
